gen-gf-gabarito-gf-kantumruy-pro: Expressive Gabarito headings lean on open-cut terminals, so each counter seems to flow outward from a single nib. And Kantumruy Pro follows in friendly sans, its e opening clearly to the right and no hairlines to snag the eye.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-kodchasan: Kodchasan sets the text in clean, open-ended strokes with no calligraphic thinning, which keeps paragraphs quiet and level. Gabarito earns its place up top, big and brief.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-koho: KoHo takes the body with wide c openings and a tidy, clean manner, while Gabarito above it is drawn like one nib, its terminals cut open. But the pair's best quality is how loud that heading gets without crowding the sans below.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-kosugi: Kosugi reads like bent wire, its open-jawed c gaping like a pair of pliers across every word. Kosugi keeps that wire-bent look going down a whole page, so Gabarito's expressive heading never has to compete with it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-kosugi-maru: Kosugi Maru glows like neon tubing, one steady line with stroke ends set far apart, under a heading that looks drawn with a single nib. Kosugi Maru is the strongest half here, a contemporary sans-serif that makes Gabarito's open terminals feel even more deliberate.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-kumbh-sans: Gabarito's terminals are cut open so its counters flow outward, as if one nib drew the whole heading. Kumbh Sans follows, with terminals stopping well short of the bowl.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-lato: Lato carries the text with wide s curves that barely curl in, drawn in a clean, professional hand. Gabarito's strokes have no thick and thin at all, so the headline stands apart from it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-libre-franklin: Libre Franklin reads clean and professional, its splayed c terminal giving the sans a little bite on the line. Gabarito's best quality is its smooth curves, with no swell where a stroke turns a corner.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-lunasima: Contemporary Lunasima keeps its c tips well apart, never creeping toward touching, while Gabarito's strokes carry no thick or thin at all. Gabarito brings the expressive voice up top, and Lunasima quietly carries the text below.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: Neutral in temperament, LXGW Marker Gothic opens its c wide like a bracelet pulled apart, with horizontals slightly slimmer than verticals. And Gabarito's s keeps its spine as thick as its terminals, so a page of text feels smooth under the heading.
